_readme: REVIEW 2026-08-25: placeholder rows removed pre-prod (11 'Untitled' slots all played the same file — all three review personas called it disqualifying). The 12-track layout is proven and returns row by row as real tracks land: add {src,title,note,year,duration,peaks} objects here. 2026-09-09: each track is a CASSETTE — its label colour is decided from the title (see tapeTint in StudioOne.astro); set `tint` to pin a tape (an oklch() colour keeps its place in the shelf's hue spacing; any other CSS colour is used as-is), and `cover` (an image path) prints on the label instead of the flat colour.
